summary: Butuan City representative with 24 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant bills are an electricity lifeline-rate expansion for minimum-wage earners, continued GSIS membership for former non-career employees and a co-authored no-work-no-pay rule for Congress. Only the economic dimension has two issues; evidence is thin.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills; no votes or statements reviewed. Economic score rests on two modest social-protection bills.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Expanded electricity lifeline rate for minimum-wage earners (-2, consumer subsidy) and continued GSIS social-insurance membership for former non-career staff (-2). No tax, labor or privatization evidence.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB08191, HB10744 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
